project_info.theme: Dark-red silk kimono lo-fi analogue editorial collage
project_info.format: vertical 4:5, four-row by two-column eight-panel grid with thin gutters
project_info.color_palette: deep red, off-white, black, warm flash midtones, gold accents

main_subject.detail: The same adult woman appears consistently across all eight panels. She has wet black hair, alternately slicked back or falling in damp strands across her face; heavy smoky eyes with smudged eyeliner; deep-red lipstick with natural texture; visible pores; glossy dark-red almond nails; chunky gold hoop earrings; and a subtle gold ring. She wears a deep-red silk kimono whose sheen and folds catch the flash.
main_subject.style: gritty lo-fi digicam and handycam fashion editorial translated into a heavy 35mm film scan

items: four-row by two-column eight-panel grid, thin gutters, consistent adult identity and styling
plain off-white wall in a small minimal indoor room
close portrait, profile, hand-detail, and kimono-fold variations across the panels
a black leather glove in selected panels and a compact vintage camera or lipstick tube as fashion props
no text, logos, watermark, cigarette, smoke, or flames

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: direct on-camera flash with harsh highlight falloff, warm midtones, and red bloom
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: deep but textured shadows, strong halation and blooming highlights around silk and lipstick
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: late-night, dark-romantic, intimate editorial, raw analogue energy

technical_specs.render_style: lo-fi digicam and handycam collage with true heavy 35mm film grain
technical_specs.color_treatment: 35mm scan character, red bleed, slight gate weave, subtle frame jitter, occasional light leaks in one or two panels, film dust, scan artifacts, and filmic softness

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 4:5 gritty lo-fi digicam and handycam fashion editorial collage arranged as a four-row by two-column eight-panel grid with thin gutters. The same adult woman must remain consistent in every panel. In a small minimal room against a plain off-white wall, she wears a deep-red silk kimono with sheen and folds catching direct on-camera flash. Her wet black hair is slicked back in some panels and falls in damp strands across her face in others. Keep heavy smoky eyes, smudged eyeliner, bold deep-red lipstick with natural texture, visible pores, glossy dark-red almond nails, chunky gold hoop earrings, and a subtle gold ring. Vary close portraits, profiles, hand details, and kimono folds across the panels. Use a black leather glove in selected panels and a compact vintage camera or lipstick tube as fashion props. Render direct-flash highlights with heavy 35mm film grain, strong halation, blooming highlights, red bloom and bleed, slight gate weave, subtle frame jitter, occasional light leaks in one or two panels, film dust, and scan artifacts. Keep the mood dark-romantic, late-night, raw, and intimate-editorial. No text, logos, watermark, cigarette, smoke, or flames.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, cigarette, smoking, smoke, lighter, flame, text, watermark, logo, weapon, gun, violence, clean digital look, modern HDR sharpness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, cartoon, CGI artifacts, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional approved-adult person, wardrobe, and moodboard references may be attached. When provided, preserve the adult identity, deep-red silk kimono, wet black hairstyle, makeup, jewelry, eight-panel grid, and analogue flash treatment; props may be substituted only with non-smoking fashion objects such as a black leather glove, compact vintage camera, or lipstick tube.

changes: Preserved the adult subject, red silk kimono, close editorial collage, styling, and dark analogue mood.
Replaced the cigarette, visible smoke, and lighter flame with non-smoking fashion props to avoid platform-risky smoking imagery.
Reframed the sensual mood as dark-romantic intimate editorial without sexualized or explicit wording.
